providers.title: Isomorphisms spread
providers.scope: If N, N' are finitely presented over B and S^(-1)N is isomorphic to S^(-1)N', the isomorphism comes from an isomorphism N_s -> N'_s for some s in S.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Gluing
providers.scope: For f_0, f_1 generating the unit ideal, 0 -> M -> M_(f_0) x M_(f_1) -> M_(f_0 f_1) is exact, and compatible isomorphisms over the two localizations glue.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quillen's lemma
providers.scope: For theta in (1 + T R_f[T])^x there is k with theta(g_1 T) theta(g_2 T)^(-1) defined over R whenever g_1 - g_2 lies in f^k A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quillen induction
providers.scope: A property of localizations of a nonzero ring K that specializes, spreads from S^(-1)K to some K_s, holds at every maximal ideal and satisfies the sheaf condition for comaximal pairs holds for K.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quillen's patching theorem
providers.scope: A finitely presented A[T]-module M which is extended from A_m for every maximal ideal m is isomorphic to (M/TM)[T].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Local criteria for projectivity
providers.scope: Finitely generated projective modules over local rings are free; a finitely presented module free at all primes is projective; projectivity can be tested on two comaximal multiplicative sets.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Horrocks' theorem in rank one
providers.scope: Over a local ring A, a finitely generated projective A[X]-module which becomes free of rank one after inverting the monic polynomials is free.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Horrocks' theorem, local form
providers.scope: Over a local ring A, a finitely generated projective A[X]-module which becomes free after inverting the monic polynomials is free.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Horrocks' theorem, affine form
providers.scope: If P is finitely generated projective over A[X] and S^(-1)P is extended from a finitely generated projective A-module, then P is isomorphic to (P/XP)[X].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quillen–Suslin theorem
providers.scope: Every finitely generated projective module over a polynomial ring F[x_1,...,x_r] over a field is free.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unimodular rows
providers.scope: Over F[x_1,...,x_r], every unimodular row is the first row of an invertible matrix.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Algebra maps spread
providers.scope: Homomorphisms and isomorphisms between finitely presented algebras over K_S come from K_s for some s in S.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Axiom Q for automorphism groups
providers.scope: Automorphism groups of a finitely presented algebra satisfy axiom Q: an automorphism over L_s[T] trivial at T = 0 becomes defined over L after the substitution T -> s^r T.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Affine part of an automorphism
providers.scope: Every automorphism of a symmetric algebra S(M_L) is a product of an automorphism tangent to the identity and an affine automorphism.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Factorization over two localizations
providers.scope: For M finitely presented and comaximal s_0, s_1, G_(M,0)(L_(s_0 s_1)) = G_(M,0)(L_(s_0))_(s_1) G_(M,0)(L_(s_1))_(s_0).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Factorization of automorphisms
providers.scope: Every automorphism of S(M) over L_(s_0 s_1) is (v_0)_(s_1) h (v_1)_(s_0) with v_i defined over L_(s_i) and h affine.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Modules over two localizations
providers.scope: Modules over comaximal localizations glue along an isomorphism, and finite presentation is local for comaximal pairs.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Symmetric algebras determine their modules
providers.scope: If S(M) and S(N) are isomorphic K-algebras, then M and N are isomorphic K-modules.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conormal module of an augmented algebra
providers.scope: For a finitely presented algebra A with an augmentation to K of kernel I, the K-module I/I^2 is finitely presented.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bass–Connell–Wright theorem
providers.scope: A finitely presented K-algebra which is a symmetric algebra after localizing at every maximal ideal of K is the symmetric algebra of a finitely presented K-module.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Locally polynomial algebras
providers.scope: A finitely presented locally polynomial algebra is S(P) with P finitely generated projective; over F[y_1,...,y_r] with F a field it is a polynomial ring.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
